LESSON: WRITING 12.5.1 THE WRITING PROCESS: DIALOGUES

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade seven
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 12
Topic 12.5: Writing 12.5.1 The writing Process: Dialogues
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Writing 12.5.1 The writing Process: Dialogues, part of Strand 12 in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade seven ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: How is dialogue and a narrative composition different?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

A. outline the format of a dialogue

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Writing 12.5.1 The writing Process: Dialogues together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Communication and collaboration: Learners develop writing skills as they write clearly and in an organised manner, as they work

together to acquire skills in good writing for effective communication.

Values:
● Responsibility is instilled as learners learn how to dress decently and respectfully.

● Unity is achieved as learners work together to generate ideas for writing tasks.

Link to other Subjects

● The learner is able to apply the writing proces to their learning in all other learning areas such as Pre-Technical Studie, Kiswahilis
